About us

A Malaysian snack maker, building trust since 1993.

Central Vista (M) Sdn Bhd manufactures and distributes snacks and confectionery from Bandar Seri Alam, Johor Bahru. From crunchy corn snacks to soft marshmallows, we make quality treats for partners around the world.

Our mission

To craft high-quality snacks and confectionery — made safely, sold honestly, and enjoyed around the world.

Our promise

Food-safety compliance, consistent quality and reliable supply for every partner, from local distributors to global brands.

Our journey

Three decades of craft

1993

The beginning

Central Vista (M) Sdn Bhd is founded in Johor with a focus on quality snacks.

2000s

Scaling up

Corn snack and confectionery lines expand to meet growing demand.

2010s

CV Mallow launches

Marshmallows, cereal bars, cookies and chocolate confectionery join the range.
